_note: Gem score weights (sum of weights = 100). Edit + re-run backtest.py to recalibrate. Reference weights were tuned on one small sample (n small); re-tune on your own alerts. Penalties subtract points.
_owner_callers_note: fallback only: the live list = tools/wallet_watch/config.json caller_feeds[*].tg if you run a wallet watcher; otherwise list the public caller channels you trust most here.

exit_lock_50.approved: template default: PAPER ONLY (owner may set active=false)
exit_lock_50.rule: profit lock (stop >= net breakeven) at peak >= +50% instead of +10%; keep half the gain from 2x; trail 35%/<3x, 30%/3-5x, 25%/>5x (STRONG+NEUTRAL), FADING 25%, past 24h 20%
exit_lock_50.code: desk/paper/paper_monitor.py EXIT_EXPERIMENTS / exit_params(); matches desk/scoring/backtest.py EXIT_VARIANT=wide
exit_lock_50.unchanged: -30% hard stop until lock, RUG/SANITY guards, BREAKING (pre-lock needs m5<=-5%), FADING partials >=+25%, 24h time stop; live desk rules + protocols/exit-rules.md untouched

contrarian_1p5x.approved: template default: PAPER ONLY (no real trades, no wallets). Owner may set active=false.
contrarian_1p5x.rule: ALSO paper-enter calls the gem filters would skip (soft fails: momentum, fake volume, already ran, liquidity caps, low-ish score, soft 'already dumped' veto) when the call came from the owner's own sources (tg_watch channels, caller watch, wallet watch/flywheel). Never on a hard veto (live mint/freeze authority, honeypot, Rugcheck rugged, Rug Shield REJECT, liq < $5K, m5 <= -50%); fail-closed if Rugcheck/sell route/liquidity unknown.
contrarian_1p5x._start_usd_note: null = inherit desk/paper/paper_config.json starting_bankroll_usd (one value; default $250)
contrarian_1p5x.code: desk/scoring/contrarian.py (hooked from gem_paper.cycle); book desk/paper/contrarian_1p5x_book.json; journal desk/paper/contrarian_1p5x_journal.jsonl; scorecard desk/reports/contrarian_1p5x_scorecard_latest.md + section in gem_scorecard_latest.md
contrarian_1p5x.unchanged: main paper book, gem entries/thresholds, exit rules v3.2a + exit_lock_50, protocols/exit-rules.md, live desk rules

_source_groups_note: Empty by default: every channel is a separate source. Group channels (channel -> group id) only if data proves they post identical calls (e.g. mirrors); grouped channels then count as ONE source.
_promo_channels_note: Public channels you consider promo/paid-shill feeds (a call ONLY from these gets the promo_only penalty). Empty by default; fill with your own picks.
_x_paid_promo_note: X accounts you have evidence are paid promoters (penalty x_paid_promo_each). Empty by default. Never add an account from its name alone; verify first.
